analysis.reason: Test expected HTTP 200 for a known valid product (ID 1) but the API responded with 404 and body {"message":"Requested item not found"}, indicating the product was not returned by the application.
analysis.recommendedAction: Verify whether product ID 1 should exist in the test environment. If it should, inspect application logs and the backing data store to determine why the item is missing or why the endpoint returns 404. If test data is not guaranteed, update test setup to seed the product or adjust the test expectation to align with the API contract.
